Play the Beta on Steam RIGHT NOW!

Get Fired Up for the Throwdown

Kiln is a pottery power-fantasy that celebrates both Creativity and Destruction: the pleasure that comes from both making beautiful things, and then smashing those things to smithereens. 

Create your pot, grab your friends, and join a team of colorful spirits who face off against one another in online arenas, where the ceramic creations you sculpt on a pottery wheel become the bodies you bring into battle.

Coming April 23, 2026. Pre-order now!

Play Day One with Game Pass Ultimate and Game Pass PC
